title: 第39章 好画儿，好样的！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚完结版免费阅读
content_zh: ';群臣齐齐看向唐敬，脸色难看。没有异议？你儿子能写得出来吗？你就敢没有异议？今日要是写不出来，丢的是我们所有人的脸，不是你唐敬的脸。唐敬看到众人盯着自己的眼神，也是冷汗涔涔，你们别这么看着我，有本事你们向陛下争取啊！“好，好，好啊……”唯独唐画，激动得呼吸都急促了起来。皇帝所要求的条件，唐逸房间中的那首《春望》不就适合吗？哈哈，那就用他的诗，来成就我吧！“陛下，小臣作为此次科考第一，理应为天下学子做个表率。”唐画当即站了出来，拱手大声道：“陛下，那首《满江红》虽然写得极好，写得慷慨激昂，然，却不过是无病呻吟罢了！”“陛下，大炎虽大，但好战必亡，这是千古不变的道理。”“《满江红》不过是误国误民之词，陛下应当弃之如敝屣。”“而我大炎诸位大臣为我大炎江山殚精竭虑，死而后已，这是我大炎之幸，他们才该是获得陛下体恤之人。”“今日，便由臣替诸位大臣，为陛下献上一首《劝谏诗》！”唐画声音正义凛然。听到他的话，群臣看着他的目光都变得柔和起来，虽然口气是狂妄了点，但这话说得很得人心嘛！我们殚精竭虑劝和，那是为了大炎的和平，为了能少死一点人。可是陛下怎么就不明白我们的苦心呢？非得再来一次靖康耻，陛下才老实？炎文帝看着唐画，眼睛也是眯了起来。哼，一开口又是满嘴的仁义道德，可耻。其他人劝谏朕，朕还尚可听一分，唯独你唐家没资格。对一个五岁的小女孩下死手，你劝谏朕？滑天下之大稽！“哦？那小爱卿，请开始你的表演吧！”炎文帝抬手，嘴角带笑，笑容中带着嘲讽。《满江红》是误国误民之诗？那朕倒是要看看，你们这些软骨头，能写出什么慷慨激昂的诗来。众人的视线，也都齐齐凝聚在唐画的身上。唐敬攥紧拳头，更是紧张到手都在冒汗，一颗心怦怦跳。唐画嘴角泛起一抹阴谋得逞的笑，他背着一只手，在大殿上信步，佯装沉思。片刻后，唐画开口了，声音中带着一丝悲戚。“国破山河在，城春草木深。”“感时花溅泪，恨别鸟惊心。”众人原本就在全神贯注，紧张又期待，现在这四句诗一出，几乎所有人的呼吸，都在此时有了一瞬整齐的停滞！短短四句，就将战后城市的破败，沧桑，凄凉感拉满。昔日繁华的城池，如今断壁残垣，如何不让人感伤，落泪？这难道不是当年靖康耻的场景吗？！炎文帝瞳孔也是微微一缩，倒是小瞧这家伙了，倒真是个有才的。短短几句诗，也勾起了他埋藏在心底深处的画面……但和群臣不同，群臣是激动，而炎文帝感到的只有耻辱。靖康耻过去十几年了，可没有谁知道，他之所以活着，是因为当年藏在了东宫的狗洞里！他们，还想他再次藏一次狗洞！“烽火连三月，家书抵万金。”“白头搔更短，浑欲……不胜簪！”后面四句，唐画猛地高高举起双手，声音陡然拔高，回声传荡全场。回声还在回荡，但整个大殿却安静得可怕。所有人的目光，都盯着站在大殿正中的青年。不知道是感动，还是之前《满江红》的耻辱，现在让人帮洗刷了，很多大臣都眼睛通红，泪眼蒙眬。原以为《满江红》已经是一时之绝唱，没想到唐画这一首《劝谏》诗，更是惊艳卓绝！最重要的是，唐画这小子说了，这首诗是站在他们角度写的。哈哈，陛下，你看呐，我们没有怯战。我们真的在忧国忧民，你看我们都忧思得头发都掉光了，连发簪都插不了了。“哈哈，谁说我们写不出来的？我们写出来了！”“谁说我们文人，写不出劝谏陛下止戈休战的诗句的？谁！”“好，不愧是金榜第一，写得好，唐侍郎，你教了个好儿子！”“……”沉寂片刻，整个大殿瞬间就沸腾了。之前被《满江红》压一头的文官，现在彻底放飞自我，激动得不顾形象咆哮连连。好在唐逸没在，唐逸要是在……他觉得杜甫要是知道自己这首忧国忧民的千古绝唱，竟然被人这么曲解解读出来了，恐怕棺材板都压不住了！唐敬激动得浑身颤抖，老眼通红。“好！好啊！好画儿，好样的！”唐敬拍着唐画的肩膀，道：“不愧是我唐敬最优秀的儿子，哈哈，太给爹长脸了。”今日起，看谁还敢在京都，说我唐敬宠妾灭妻！唯独一群武将，看着激动的文臣都懵逼了。写得很好嘛？病恹恹的没半点气势，哪里好了。炎文帝此时脸色也有些复杂，看来，还真是小看唐敬了。这老匹夫私德很差，但不得不承认生的儿子很有才。一个唐逸，一个唐画……可惜了，要是唐敬能善待唐逸，那唐家就是一门双杰，要是算上唐敬，那就是一门三进士！这是何等的荣耀？“很好，小爱卿不愧是金榜第一名，果然才气过人。”炎文帝拍了拍手，道：“就凭这一首诗，朕钦点你为此次科考的状元，任翰林院修撰。”唐画一听，激动得眼睛都红了。翰林院修撰，朝中重臣哪个不是翰林院出来的？想要封王拜相，首先你得是翰林院出身。但唐画又岂会满足于一个小小的六品修撰，现在正是拉拢群臣，在群臣心中打好形象的好机会，岂能错过。“陛下，臣宁肯不要这状元，只求陛下止戈休战，与民用息。”唐画跪了下来，脑袋重重磕在地上，道：“臣请陛下为我大炎江山社稷，与北狄和谈，莫要再起刀兵。”一众主和的大臣，也都齐齐站了出来附和。“陛下，唐状元说得对，请陛下收刀兵，和谈。”“陛下，为江山社稷，望陛下三思，莫要真让我大炎山河破碎。”“陛下，臣附议！”“……”唐画看到身后乌压压跪着的一群人，只觉得热血沸腾，一种带头大哥的自豪感油然而生。这种感觉贼爽！
content_en: '; All the officials looked at Tang Jing with ugly expressions.No objection?Can your son write it?Do you dare to have no objection?If I can't write it today, it will be a disgrace to all of us, not to you, Tang Jing.Tang Jing was sweating when he saw the eyes of everyone staring at him. Don't look at me like that. If you have the ability, fight for it from His Majesty!"Okay, okay, okay..." Only Tang Hua was so excited that his breathing became rapid.For the conditions required by the emperor, wouldn't the song "Spring Hope" in Tang Yi's room be suitable?Haha, then use his poems to fulfill me!"Your Majesty, as I am number one in this scientific examination, I should set an example for the students all over the world." Tang Hua immediately stood up, raised his hands and said loudly: "Your Majesty, although the song "Man Jiang Hong" is excellent and impassioned, it is just a moan for nothing!" "Your Majesty, although the Great Inflammation is strong, but those who are warlike will perish, this is an eternal truth.""Man Jiang Hong" is just a word that harms the country and the people, and your Majesty should discard it like a waste." "It is my great fortune that the ministers of Dayan worked hard for my country, and they should be the ones to receive your majesty's sympathy." "Today, I will present a "poem of advice" to your majesty on behalf of the ministers!" Tang Hua's voice was righteous.After hearing his words, the ministers' eyes softened when they looked at him. Although his tone was a bit arrogant, his words were very popular!We tried our best to persuade them to make peace, for the sake of peace in Dayan, and so that fewer people would die.But why doesn’t Your Majesty understand our painstaking efforts?Do you have to suffer the humiliation of Jingkang again to make your majesty honest?Emperor Yanwen looked at Tang Hua and narrowed his eyes.Huh, it's shameful to talk about benevolence, justice and morality when you open your mouth.Others are admonishing me, but I can still listen to them, but you, the Tang family, are not qualified.Do you advise me on killing a five-year-old girl?The most ridiculous thing in the world!"Oh? Then, little Aiqing, please start your performance!" Emperor Yan Wen raised his hand with a smile on his face, and the smile was sarcastic.Is "Man Jiang Hong" a poem that harms the country and the people?Then I want to see what impassioned poems you weaklings can write.Everyone's eyes were also focused on Tang Hua.Tang Jing clenched his fists, and was so nervous that his hands were sweating and his heart was pounding.A hint of a conspiratorial smile appeared on Tang Hua's lips. He walked around the main hall with one hand behind his back, pretending to be deep in thought.After a moment, Tang Hua spoke, with a hint of sadness in his voice."The country is broken, the mountains and rivers are there, the city is springy and the vegetation is deep." "The flowers splash with tears when I feel the time, and the birds are frightened at the sight of others." Everyone had been concentrating, nervous and looking forward to it, but now as soon as these four lines of poetry came out, almost everyone's breathing stopped neatly for a moment!In just four sentences, the postwar city's dilapidation, vicissitudes, and desolation are conveyed.The once prosperous city is now in ruins. How can we not make people feel sad and cry?Isn't this the scene of Jingkang's shame?!Emperor Yanwen's pupils also shrank slightly, he looked down upon this guy, he was really talented.Just a few lines of poetry also evoked the images buried deep in his heart... But unlike the other ministers, who were excited, Emperor Yanwen only felt shame.More than ten years have passed since Jingkang's shame, but no one knows that the reason why he is alive is because he hid in the dog hole in the East Palace!They wanted him to hide in the dog hole again!"The war rages for three months, and a letter from home is worth ten thousand gold." "The hairpin is even shorter, and the lust is... too much for hairpins!" In the last four sentences, Tang Hua suddenly raised his hands high, his voice suddenly rose, and the echoes filled the whole room.The echoes were still echoing, but the entire hall was eerily quiet.Everyone's eyes were fixed on the young man standing in the middle of the hall.I don’t know whether it was because I was moved, or because the shame of "Man Jiang Hong" was washed away by others now. Many ministers' eyes were red and filled with tears.I originally thought that "Man Jiang Hong" was already a masterpiece, but I didn't expect that this poem "Admonishment" written by Tang Hua would be even more amazing!The most important thing is that this guy Tang Hua said that this poem was written from their perspective.Haha, Your Majesty, look, we are not timid.We are really worried about the country and the people. You see, we are all so worried that our hair has fallen out and we can’t even insert hairpins."Haha, who said we couldn't write it? We wrote it!" "Who said we literati can't write poems to persuade His Majesty to stop fighting? Who!" "Okay, worthy of being number one on the gold list, well written, Minister Tang, you have taught a good son!" "..." After a moment of silence, the entire hall was boiling.The civil servants who were previously overwhelmed by "River Red" now let themselves go completely and were so excited that they roared again and again regardless of their image.Fortunately, Tang Yi was not here. If Tang Yi was here... He felt that if Du Fu knew that his eternal song of concern for the country and the people had been misinterpreted in this way, I am afraid that the coffin board would not be able to hold it down!Tang Jing was so excited that his whole body was shaking and his old eyes were red."Okay! Okay! Good painting, well done!" Tang Jing patted Tang Hua on the shoulder and said, "He is indeed the best son of me, Tang Jing. Haha, I'm so proud of my father." From today on, let's see who dares to accuse me, Tang Jing, of spoiling my concubine and destroying my wife!Only a group of military generals were stunned to see the excited civil servants.Is it well written?He is so sick that he has no energy at all. How can he feel better?Emperor Yanwen's expression was a little complicated at this time. It seemed that he really underestimated Tang Jing.This old man has very bad personal ethics, but he has to admit that the son he gave birth to is very talented.One Tang Yi, one Tang Hua... It's a pity. If Tang Jing could treat Tang Yi kindly, then the Tang family would be a double master, and if Tang Jing was included, it would be a triple master!What an honor is this?"Very good, little Aiqing deserves to be number one on the gold list. She is indeed very talented." Emperor Yanwen clapped his hands and said, "Based on this poem, I hand-pick you to be the number one scholar in this scientific examination and to be the editor of the Hanlin Academy." When Tang Hua heard this, his eyes were red with excitement.Compiled by the Hanlin Academy, which of the important officials in the court did not come from the Hanlin Academy?If you want to be crowned king or prime minister, you must first be from the Hanlin Academy.But how can Tang Hua be satisfied with a small sixth-grade compilation? Now is a good opportunity to win over the officials and build a good image in the hearts of the officials. How can we miss it?"Your Majesty, I would rather not have this number one scholar. I just ask that your Majesty stop the war and make peace with the people." Tang Hua knelt down, knocked his head heavily on the ground, and said: "I ask your Majesty to negotiate peace with Beidi for my Yanjiangshan Sheji, and not to start another war." All the ministers who advocated peace also stood up to agree."Your Majesty, the Emperor of the Tang Dynasty is right. Please put away your weapons.
